 🏆 Kane the difference on big night; Italy stun France; Spain win again 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article LIVE 
 England 2 Croatia 1 Today Full time Italy 3 France 1 Today Full time Czechia 0 Spain 2 Today Full time 3 hours ago 13:43 FULL TIME! 
 OneFootball Videos
 Harry Kane seals the win for England on his big night and a famous victory in Spain on Sunday will see them top the group. 
 The world champions extend their record unbeaten run to a staggering 44 games with a comfortable win in Prague. 
 The biggest winner of the night though is Italy, who stormed back against France to win 3-1. Roberto Mancini's second reign has lift-off!
 3 hours ago 13:42 GOAL! SPAIN SEAL IT! 
 Marc Pubill gets his second goal for his country right at the death and it's another win for Luis de la Fuente and his men. 
 3 hours ago 13:30 GOAL DISALLOWED! 
 James Garner thinks he has his first England goal but Jude Bellingham was just offside in the build up. 
 Croatia are still alive. 
 3 hours ago 13:29 A win here will put Italy top of the group, ahead of the French on goal difference. 
 The Azzurri face Belgium on Sunday - the Red Devils can also win the group - in what is set to be a thriller. 
 3 hours ago 13:26 GOAL! 3-1 ITALY! 
 What a night in Milan and it's fitting Inter's Esposito is the star of it all. 
 He gets his second and Italy's third from the spot, surely sealing the win in the process. 
 A huge win for Roberto Mancini. 
 4 hours ago 13:20 Luka Modrić is on with little over 10 minutes to go. 
 Could another former Spurs man have the final say here?
 4 hours ago 13:18 Czechia's hopes of grabbing a point against the world champions is hanging by a thread after the dismissal of their captain, Ladislav Krejčí. 
 4 hours ago 13:11 GOAL! ITALY TURN IT AROUND! 
 Davide Frattesi sends the San Siro wild, smashing home at the near post from Federico DiMarco's dangerous cross. 
 Is their 64-year home drought ending against the French about to end? Will Zidane taste defeat for the first time?
 4 hours ago 13:08 GOAL! KANE GETS HIS GOAL! 
 The England captain makes no mistake on his big night, putting the ball down the middle in cool fashion. 
 A record-extending 92nd England goal on his record-breaking 126th England cap.
 4 hours ago 13:06 There's a potential penalty here for England though and the referee is going to the monitor. 
 He's given it for pulling on Quansah of all people!
 4 hours ago 13:05 GOAL! CROATIA LEVEL! 
 Out of nowhere!
 It's an absolute disaster for Jarell Quansah who, instead of dealing with a corner, tries to head it back to Jordan Pickford from close range. 
 Petar Sučić nips into put the ball into the net to level things up. 
 The Inter man was taken off at half-time of the 7-0 rout - what a turnaround. 
 4 hours ago 12:59 GOAL DISALLOWED! 
 Pino is ruled to be offside after a VAR check. 
 Hope for Czechia!
 4 hours ago 12:54 SPAIN DOUBLE THEIR LEAD! 
 Just three minutes into the second half and Spain should be home and hosed. 
 Crystal Palace's Yéremy Pino has doubled their lead with a cool finish after latching onto Unai Simón's long ball. 
 It was more likely a pass in truth though. It is Spain we're talking about after all!
 4 hours ago 12:51 And we're back underway - what's in store for the next 45 minutes?
 4 hours ago 12:35 HALF TIME! 
 England and Spain lead at the break while Italy and France are level. 
 4 hours ago 12:32 Closing in on half time in London, Milan and Prague. 
 Will we see another goal before the break?
 4 hours ago 12:27 GOAL! SPAIN STRIKE! 
 Commenators curse!
 The world champions lead via a penalty from Álex Baena. 
 Will they ever lose again?
 4 hours ago 12:24 As you might expect, Spain are dominating possession in Prague but Czechia are holding firm. 
 4 hours ago 12:24 Croatia have done well after going behind. Surely there won't be another hammering. 
 5 hours ago 12:18 It's been a while since we've seen a world class Italian striker. Could the Inter starlet be that guy?
 🚨🚨| GOAL: ESPOSITO EQUALIZES FOR ITALY!!!
Italy 1-1 France  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 5 hours ago 12:17 GOAL! ITALY LEVEL! 
 Pio Espositio atones for Donnarumma's error, drawing the Azzurri level with a neat close-range finish. 
 That's his eight international goal in just 13 and-a-bit-caps!
 5 hours ago 12:14 GOAL! ENGLAND LEAD! 
 England had barely had a shot but they now lead in fortuitous fashion. 
 Harry Kane has a role to play on his big night, angling the ball towards Jude Bellingham in the box.
 The Real Madrid puts the ball across the box for Rogers, who just about gets the ball over the line after Joško Gvardiol makes a mess of his clearance. 
 5 hours ago 12:09 Italy haven't won at home to France in a remarkable 64 years and their bid to end that drought has been all the harder by their one-time reliable keeper. 
 OUVERTURE DU SCORE de nos Bleus signée Olise dès la 10e minute 🔥
🇮🇹0-1🇫🇷 #ITAFRA  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 5 hours ago 12:05 The City keeper tried playing from the back and simply passed the ball to Olise, who eventually finished past him with aplomb. 
 5 hours ago 12:04 GOAL! FRANCE LEAD! 
 Les Bleus might be without their captain but they do have Michael Olise. 
 The Bayern Munich superstar has opened the scoring at the San Siro and it's another absolute howler from Gianluigi Donnarumma....
 5 hours ago 11:57 Little to report on so far. 
 Having been hit for seven in a stunning rout just weeks ago, Croatia look extra determined to keep things tight at Wembley. 
 5 hours ago 11:53 Is he England's greatest ever?
 📸 Justin Setterfield - 2026 Getty Images
 5 hours ago 11:51 Some more Kane footage here - will he mark his big night with a goal??
 The best in the world. 
The skipper shares a moment with supporters to celebrate his #BallonDor success 🥇  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 5 hours ago 11:47 KICK OFF! 
 And we're under way in our three games. 
 5 hours ago 11:46 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Harry Kane… England’s records man & Ballon d’Or winner
❓ Now our country’s greatest? Only Sir Bobby Charlton for competition, you feel  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 5 hours ago 11:45 Kane is also parading his Ballon d'Or trophy to the Wembley crowd. 
 Pictures and videos to follow on a huge night for the England skipper. 
 5 hours ago 11:43 Minutes away from kick off in our three games. 
 It's a hugely special night for Harry Kane as he prepares to break the England cap record. 
 Peter Shilton - the current co-holder - is handing over the trophy to his successor while Prince William and Luka Modric are also on hand.
 6 hours ago 11:06 Here's the French side Zinedine Zidane has picked with Adrien Rabiot captaining in Kylian Mbappé's absence. 
 Le XI des Bleus pour affronter l'Italie ⚔️🇫🇷
⌚️ 20h45 sur TF1 📺
#ITAFRA  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 6 hours ago 10:56 And here are the two XIs for tonight's game at Wembley. Can Croatia avenge that 7-0 drubbing?
 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Harry Kane vs Josip Stanišić 🇭🇷
Kick-off: 20:45 CET  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 6 hours ago 10:49 The England squad look ready for business at Wembley ...
 Focused on the job ahead 👊  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 6 hours ago 10:37 Elsewhere for England, Trent starts at right back whilst Jobe Bellingham and Josh King are named on the bench.
 6 hours ago 10:36 Harry Kane will become England's all-time appearance holder ...
 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 Harry Kane makes his 126th appearance for England, officially becoming England's all-time most-capped player  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 6 hours ago 10:33 And here's the Italy XI for their blockbuster match with France ...
 Gli 1️⃣1️⃣ #Azzurri scelti dal Ct Roberto Mancini!
🇮🇹 Italia 🆚 Francia 🇫🇷

📺 Rai Uno
#ItaliaFrancia #NationsLeague
#Nazionale #VivoAzzurro  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 6 hours ago 10:32 The England starting XI is in ...
 Your #ThreeLions to take on Croatia 👊
Harry Kane is set to make a historic 126th England appearance ❤️  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 7 hours ago 10:19 In the meantime Spain have named their XI for the game in Prague ...
 👥 Con este 𝗢𝗡𝗖𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗜𝗔𝗟 salimos en Praga.
#VamosEspaña | #NationsLeague  –  Thursday, 12 November 2026 
 7 hours ago 10:07 Elsewhere for the Three Lions, will we see the first brothers to play for England since the Nevilles with Jude and Jobe Bellingham both in the squad for the first time. Team news from north London should be with us in half an hour or so.
 7 hours ago 10:06 The big news from Wembley is that Harry Kane will be honoured before kick off ahead of becoming England's all-time leading appearance-maker. The Bayern striker will overtake Peter Shilton and earn his 126th cap.
 7 hours ago 10:05 Good evening everyone and welcome to our live blog of tonight's Nations League matches. We've got England's clash with Croatia, Italy taking on France and Spain travelling to Czechia. You can keep up to date with all the action once the matches kick off in roughly an hour and 45 minutes' time.
